body:
# MobToggle

**Tired of phantoms ruining your nights or creepers blowing up your builds?** MobToggle lets you disable natural spawning for any hostile vanilla mob right from inside the game.

***

## What it does

Open the GUI with `/mobtoggle`, click the mobs you want to turn off, and hit Save. That's it. Your settings stick between sessions, so you never have to do it twice.

If you'd rather not open the game to change things, there's a plain JSON config file in your config folder that works just as well.

***

## Features

- Simple in-game toggle menu, one button per mob
- Works on singleplayer worlds and servers
- Settings save automatically to a config file
- No extra mods required, just Fabric API

***

## Compatibility

Currently supports **Minecraft 1.21.1**. Full support for all 1.21.x versions is on the way.

***

## Installation

Drop the jar into your mods folder alongside Fabric API and you're good to go.
